pages.title: Sliding Maze
pages.creator: NAbber Games
pages.description: Plan a route for a ball that cannot stop between walls in Sliding Maze. Swipe or use WASD or the arrows to send it sliding until an obstacle blocks it. Gather every gem to unlock the goal, keeping away from pits that return you to the start. Completing a puzzle in fewer moves earns more stars. Undo and Hint can help with a difficult route, while ball skins and a daily streak offer further goals.

pages.title: Witchy Sisters – Relax Puzzle
pages.creator: MorionStudio
pages.description: Search, organize, and make matches in Witchy Sisters – Relax Puzzle. Its witch-themed puzzles ask you to locate hidden items, sort magical objects, and identify matching shapes, colors, or patterns. Click or tap an object to interact with it, and drag when you need to move something. The different puzzle activities change what you need to find or arrange in each scene.

pages.title: Cat vs Granny. Cat Simulator
pages.creator: MagicFox
pages.description: Cause household trouble from a cat's point of view in Cat vs Granny. Cat Simulator. Complete tasks while annoying Granny: break pots, take fish from the aquarium, throw objects, and scratch the furnishings. Move with WASD, run with Shift, and jump with Space. E picks up or puts down objects, F interacts, and the left mouse button throws or shoots. On a phone, a joystick handles movement while swiping the other side controls the camera.

pages.title: Bubble Pop Legend
pages.creator: Anna Inc
pages.description: Clear the board with color-matched shots in Bubble Pop Legend. Swipe to aim the shooter and tap to fire, joining at least three bubbles of one color to pop the group. Remove all the colorful bubbles to finish a level and earn coins. Using fewer shots raises your score and helps toward a three-star result, with boosters available for difficult arrangements.

pages.title: Kings and Queens Match 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match royal treasures and open more of the kingdom in Kings and Queens Match 3. Group at least three jewels, crowns, or other identical items to remove them. Each level has its own objective and a limited supply of moves, so matches need to help complete that task. Royal Bombs, Hammers, and other boosters can remove blockers, while daily challenges provide additional rewards.

pages.title: Hero Transform Run
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Build up a superhero's energy during a run in Hero Transform Run. The game combines parkour stages with combat, letting the hero develop through upgrades before facing enemies at the end of a level. Use mouse clicks or taps to play through the running and fighting challenge, working toward defeating the opponents waiting at the finish.

pages.title: Shape Transforming: Shifting Run
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Change your character's form to match the terrain in Shape Transforming: Shifting Run. Each environment calls for a suitable transformation, so choose the form that can handle the section ahead as you work toward winning the run. Later levels introduce more difficult challenges.

pages.title: Tung Tung Sahur in Geometry Dash
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Guide a wooden, drum-carrying character past neon hazards in Tung Tung Sahur in Geometry Dash. Use the mouse controls to time jumps over spikes and traps as the route moves through a city before dawn. Speed pads and gravity changes alter the challenge along the way. The movement follows a rhythmic setting built around the character's calls as you try to reach the end.

pages.title: Match-3: Dream Room
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Solve matching puzzles while furnishing a room in Match-3: Dream Room. Select two neighboring pieces and swap them to create a horizontal or vertical line containing at least three of the same kind. A successful line disappears, awards points, and allows new pieces to drop into the empty spaces. The matching activity accompanies the game's room-building and furnishing theme.

pages.title: Badlands Hero
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Move a hero through enemy-filled battlefields in Badlands Hero. Your character fires automatically when enemies appear, leaving you to manage movement during the fighting. Complete levels, confront bosses, and collect experience to unlock other heroes. Gold can improve your gear, and different weapon types expand the fighting options. Use WASD or the left mouse button to move on a computer, or drag on the touchscreen.

pages.title: Chess Duel
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Play timed matches and build your rating in Chess Duel. Choose Bullet, Blitz, or Classic, each with its own game duration and added time per turn. Wins earn ELO points as you move through ranks ranging from Bronze to Diamond.

pages.title: Slingshot Master
pages.creator: Nexus
pages.description: Launch your hero at stickman enemies in Slingshot Master. Hold the left mouse button and drag to aim the slingshot, setting up the flight that will carry the character toward the targets. Eliminate the opposing stickmen to work through the levels. New challenges and enemies change the launch you need to prepare as you progress.

pages.title: FNF 2 Player
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Match the on-screen arrows to the music in FNF 2 Player. Press each direction at the right moment to gain points, and hold the key for long arrows; mistakes reduce your score. Player one controls directions with the arrows; player two has WASD. Story Mode offers character battles, Freeplay lets you select a song, and the two-player mode lets friends compete simultaneously with their chosen characters.

pages.title: Geometry Stars
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Jump, fly, and flip through a rhythm-based obstacle course in Geometry Stars. Use mouse or touch controls to guide the character through dark caves, avoiding spikes and the other dangers along the route. Collect stars to upgrade characters as you work through the levels. Music accompanies the movement challenges, with monsters and secrets to encounter during the journey.

pages.title: Dog Escape
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Help a dog get through guarded rooms in Dog Escape. Swipe with the mouse or a finger to navigate mazes filled with obstacles and traps. Closets offer hiding places where the dog can avoid detection, while buttons can switch off electrical hazards or clear a blocked route. You can also find dog treats along the way. The rooms become more challenging as you advance through the levels.

pages.title: Pin Board Puzzle
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Work out how to release tangled metal pieces in Pin Board Puzzle. Screws, nuts, bolts, and overlapping iron plates form the obstacles in each arrangement. Unscrew and reposition the fasteners to free the pieces, considering which connections are holding them in place. The puzzle centers on finding an order of actions that untangles the construction.

pages.title: 2048 Drop Merge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Build larger numbered pieces in 2048 Drop Merge. Drag and release to launch a number into the play area, arranging drops so pieces can merge into higher values. The target is to create a 2048 tile. Choosing where to send each number is part of preparing the next merge as the board's arrangement changes.

pages.title: Hill Station Bus Simulator
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Transport passengers along winding mountain roads in Hill Station Bus Simulator. Steep climbs and bends make controlling the bus part of each journey through the hill-station setting. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, apply the handbrake with Space, and press C to change the camera. Press R to reset.

pages.title: Ice fishing 3d
pages.creator: dreamgames
pages.description: Fish through the ice of a frozen lake in Ice fishing 3d. Put bait on the hook, then unwind the reel to lower it into the water. Different fish live at different depths, so adjust how far down the bait sits. Raise and lower the rod to attract a fish and work toward a catch. The activity follows the preparation and handling of the fishing tackle in its winter setting.

pages.title: Tropical Cubes 2048
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Combine tumbling numbered cubes in Tropical Cubes 2048. Two cubes with the same value merge into one worth twice as much, so a pair of twos becomes a four. Different values stay separate and accumulate in the play area; allowing it to overflow can end the attempt. Use the physics of each throw to bring matching cubes together, build your score, and work toward 2048. A booster is also available to help with the puzzle.

pages.title: Apex Football Battle
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Play friendly soccer matches in Apex Football Battle. Move a player with WASD or the arrow keys, using passes and crosses to build an attack before taking a shot. Space shoots, N passes, M sends a through ball, and K crosses. Press J to switch the controlled player, letting you move between members of the team as the match develops.

pages.title: Bird Tiles Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear bird tiles by collecting matching trios in Bird Tiles Match. Select tiles from the layout to place them in a holding stack with nine spaces. Three identical tiles disappear together, freeing room for more selections. Empty the entire layout without overfilling the stack, using a shuffle when you need another arrangement. Play with the mouse or touchpad.

pages.title: Princess Wedding Dress Up Game
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Prepare four royal brides for their ceremonies in Princess Wedding Dress Up Game. Explore the wedding salon's bridal outfits and choose a dress for each princess to wear on her wedding day. Use the left mouse button to change the clothing selections. The activity focuses on styling the four brides for their ceremonies and celebrations.

pages.title: Grass Reaper
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Harvest grass and improve your mowing machine in Grass Reaper. Slide to move the reaper through a level and gather the required amount of grass. Its starting capacity is limited, so make trips to sell what you have collected. Spend the gold on upgrades that help the reaper handle the work more efficiently as you continue harvesting.

pages.title: Bucket Crusher
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Break brick walls with a demolition machine in Bucket Crusher. Tap and guide the crusher toward the wall to tear it apart, earning gold coins from the destruction. Spend those coins on machine upgrades before tackling more demanding stages. The early walls are small, while later levels contain more bricks for the crusher to remove.

pages.title: Pet Healer - Vet Hospital
pages.creator: Gmamba Studio
pages.description: Develop an animal clinic in Pet Healer - Vet Hospital. Help treat the pets brought to the hospital, collecting coins to buy equipment and unlock additional medicine. These improvements expand the clinic's treatment activities as you work with different animal illnesses in the game. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or by holding the left mouse button.

pages.title: Zombie Reform
pages.description:
Fight through increasingly powerful zombies in Zombie Reform. This three-dimensional survival shooter has six maps, with the setting changing every 12 levels. Destroy the zombies to keep advancing, and face boss battles along the way.

Move with WASD and fire with the left mouse button. R reloads, C crouches, and the number keys 1–3 switch weapons. The right mouse button changes the camera. The enemies become stronger as you progress through the level system.

pages.title: Stumble Boys Sliding Puzzle
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rebuild character pictures against the clock in Stumble Boys Sliding Puzzle. Drag image pieces into new positions until they form the complete picture, using the mouse or touchscreen to rearrange them. There are 12 puzzles to work through, with a time limit for each one. Finish the current image before the time expires to continue to the next puzzle.

pages.title: Christmas Grab Match 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Move festive pieces between columns in Christmas Grab Match 3. Pick up a Christmas item and drop it at the top of another column, arranging matching pieces into horizontal or vertical lines. A line containing at least three of the same item disappears from the board. Use the mouse or tap controls to choose the item and its new column.

pages.title: OMG Word Swipe
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Trace words through a board of letters in OMG Word Swipe. Swipe across connected letter boxes to spell the words required by the puzzle. Finding every requested word completes the board, and using fewer attempts earns a higher score. Hints can reveal a letter in a required word when you need help deciding what to look for next.

pages.title: Martial Arts: Fighter Duel
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Choose among 17 fighters and enter a martial-arts tournament in Martial Arts: Fighter Duel. Play Arcade mode against opponents or challenge a friend in 2 Player mode, with adjustable difficulty in the settings. Player one moves with WASD, punches with F, G, and H, and kicks with C, V, and B. Player two uses the arrows, U/I/O for punches, and J/K/L for kicks.

pages.title: Red and Blue Cats
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help two alien companions escape a dangerous spaceship in Red and Blue Cats. Work with a friend to collect the key and reach the door, avoiding the monsters and traps aboard the ship. Diamonds add to your score along the route. Use WASD and the arrow keys, or mobile touch controls, and take advantage of double jumps to cross the obstacles.

pages.title: Princess Happy Easter
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare a reunion party in Princess Happy Easter. The princesses want outfits for their Easter gathering and cookies decorated in their own styles. Help with both activities, trying clothing combinations and choosing how to decorate the cookies. Use the left mouse button to make selections as you put together the party looks and decorated treats.

pages.title: Perfect First Date
pages.creator: FreezeNova.Games
pages.description: Get a girl ready for her date in Perfect First Date. Work through the makeover choices, changing details such as her hair, makeup, and dress to assemble the finished look. Tap to make selections and compare the different combinations.

pages.title: Bubble Warriors
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Hold back an advancing bubble army in Bubble Warriors. Aim and shoot to form matches of at least three bubbles, clearing a route to the key that opens the next mission. Iron warriors need bombs or spikes to remove them, adding a different obstacle to the matching. Finish before the mission timer expires; remaining time earns extra points. Use mouse or touch-pad controls to play.

pages.title: Jeff The Killer The Hunt for The Slenderman
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search your changed hometown for Slenderman in Jeff The Killer The Hunt for The Slenderman. Explore the map for weapons and ammunition while surviving attacks from monsters helping him. Before confronting Slenderman, you must complete tasks that lead toward his hiding place. The hunt combines exploring the town, gathering supplies, and fighting off threats as you work toward finding the main enemy.

pages.title: SHAPES GAME
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Recognize geometric shapes in SHAPES GAME. Drag each shape into the place where it belongs, comparing its form with the target before letting go.

pages.title: Ragdoll Soccer
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Send a physics-driven player after the ball in Ragdoll Soccer. Keep the character in one piece while trying to score, either in the single-player challenges or a two-player football match. Player one moves with WASD and uses Space to release or launch the rope. Player two moves with the arrows and uses L for the rope, combining character movement with rope control during play.

pages.title: Tug of Heads
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Protect your wrestler's head in Tug of Heads. Challenge the computer or a friend, choose how many sets to play, and wrestle through more than 50 stages whose conditions change between levels. Player one uses W, A, and D; player two uses Up, Left, and Right. Touch controls are also available, letting you take on the changing wrestling challenges on a touchscreen.

pages.title: Vacation Airplanes Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Assemble aircraft pictures in Vacation Airplanes Jigsaw. Pick one of 12 images, then choose how many pieces to work with: 25 on easy, 49 on medium, or 100 on hard. Use the mouse or touchscreen to put the image back together. The difficulty selection lets you try the same picture with a larger set of pieces when you want another puzzle.

pages.title: ATV Quad Bike Traffic Racer
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Ride a quad bike through highway traffic in ATV Quad Bike Traffic Racer. The game combines road racing with shooting at vehicles, adding weapon action to the traffic-driving challenge. Control the bike with the keyboard arrows as you move along the highway. Scores and best results give you a record to improve across further runs.

pages.title: Spooky Ghosts Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Put ghost-themed pictures together in Spooky Ghosts Jigsaw. There are 12 images to choose from, each available in three piece counts: 25, 49, or 100. Select an easy, medium, or hard puzzle and assemble the complete picture with mouse or touch controls. More pieces divide the illustration into smaller sections, changing how much detail you need to match.

pages.title: Jul Trivia Quiz
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Answer questions across six categories in Jul Trivia Quiz. Use the mouse to select responses and build your score. The quiz offers single-choice, multiple-choice, and true-or-false question formats, along with timed and untimed settings. Choose a category and setup, then work through its questions, checking the score at the end and trying to improve your best result.

pages.title: Free City Drive
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a vehicle and drive around the city in Free City Drive. The car simulator includes several vehicles and customization options, letting you change your car before taking it onto the streets. Use WASD to drive, Left Shift for nitro, and Space for the handbrake. Press C to change the camera, or Escape or Tab to pause the drive.

pages.title: Racing Cars Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Remember where the cars are hidden in Racing Cars Memory. Click or tap cards to turn them over and look for two showing the same racing car. Later levels add more cards, up to a maximum of 32, expanding the set of positions you need to remember. Use each revealed picture to help locate its matching partner.

pages.title: Paint Run 3D
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Cover the route with color in Paint Run 3D. Tap or click to make the painter run along the path and leave paint behind. Your goal is to color every part of the route.

pages.title: Real Taxi Car Stunts 3D Game
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Take a taxi through checkpoint courses in Real Taxi Car Stunts 3D Game. Guide the car toward the finish, managing the stunt route while a level timer adds pressure. Falling from the course can end the attempt. The game also includes a car-selection area with vehicles to purchase, giving you other choices for the driving challenges.

pages.title: Cargo Heavy Trailer Transport Sim
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: Deliver heavy cargo to the warehouse in Cargo Heavy Trailer Transport Sim. Drive a large truck through forest, desert, and off-road environments, keeping the load moving safely toward its destination. The game contains more than ten delivery levels. Steer with WASD and use Space to brake as you work through the different transport routes.

pages.title: Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw 2020
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Carry passengers over rough terrain in Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw 2020. Pick up customers in your three-wheeled rickshaw and take them to their destinations, earning money for successful drop-offs. Spend those earnings on better rickshaws for later journeys. WASD or the arrow keys control the vehicle as you handle the passenger routes.

pages.title: Kara Climb
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Help Kara reach a mountain summit in Kara Climb. Jump between stone platforms and cross the holes without falling, choosing between normal and double jumps to cover the gaps. A time limit keeps the climb moving, and running out of time ends the game. Use the mouse or tap controls to play while watching the next landing point.

pages.title: Hop Ballz 3D
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Keep a bouncing ball landing on musical tiles in Hop Ballz 3D. Guide it with mouse or touch controls while following the music, making sure the next bounce reaches a tile. Missing one sends the ball falling. Gather stars along the way and use them in the shop to buy different balls, then work toward a stronger leaderboard result.

pages.title: Leaping Gems
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Steer a ship through a gem-shooting challenge in Leaping Gems. Move left and right with A and D, lining up with the moving gems so your shots can damage and destroy them. The game tracks your score and offers firing upgrades, including faster shooting. Keep adjusting your position to bring the remaining gems into your firing line.

pages.title: Robot Shooting
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Defend your planet from approaching aliens in Robot Shooting. Click an enemy to fire at it, trying to destroy the attackers before they reach your robot. The game tracks a score and high score as you work through its levels. Watch for enemies closing in and choose the next target before it gets too near.

pages.title: Birthday Cake
pages.creator: JoyBits
pages.description: Fold neighboring pieces together to build a layered treat in Birthday Cake. Use the mouse to turn sections over onto one another, combining the layout into a stack. Each fold changes the arrangement available for your next move. Complete the cake puzzle to continue to another level, planning how the remaining pieces can come together.

pages.title: Dress Up Wheel
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Let a spin choose Mira's fashion challenge in Dress Up Wheel. The wheel leads to four clothing themes: retro, classy, rockstar, and school style. Use the mouse to explore the clothes available for the selected look and put together an outfit for Mira. The random style selection gives each dress-up round its starting point.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjongg Alchemy
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Match mystical tiles through a series of alchemy-themed puzzles in Arkadium's Mahjongg Alchemy. Look for matching symbols in the arrangement and select the tiles that belong together as you work through the layouts. The game gives its mahjongg puzzles a magical setting, with tile matching at the center of progression.

pages.title: Leap and Jump
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Switch between the sides of a dangerous passage in Leap and Jump. Click to leap across, timing the move to avoid the hazards along the route. Collisions cost health, while health pickups can restore it and help the run continue. Keep moving through the obstacles and try to improve the score recorded from your earlier attempts.

pages.title: Ramp Car Stunts Racing Impossible Tracks 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Complete driving missions in Ramp Car Stunts Racing Impossible Tracks 3D. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys and follow the car courses toward each stage's completion point. The game uses separate levels with checkpoints and mission results, opening further courses as you progress. Keep the car positioned for the next section as you work through the route.

pages.title: Pill Volley
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Rally with pill-shaped characters in Pill Volley. Play a solo match or share a two-player game, sending the volleyball across the net while defending your side of the court. Player one uses the Up arrow and player two uses W. Time your actions around the ball's movement to keep the rally going and challenge the opposing player.

pages.title: Miami City Crime Simulator City Mafia War
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take on city-mafia missions as a flying hero in Miami City Crime Simulator City Mafia War. Fight the gangsters threatening the city and work through the combat assignments. Use WASD to move, Space to jump, Shift to run, and F to fly. These movement options let you travel through the city as you approach the next mission objective.

pages.title: Cricket World Cup Game 2019 Mini Ground Cricke
pages.creator: BRAVO
pages.description: Move the bat and score runs in Cricket World Cup Game 2019 Mini Ground Cricke. Use the mouse to shift left and right, then select a shot with the arrows shown during play. Before the match, choose a duration of one and a half, two and a half, or three and a half minutes. Losing all ten wickets ends your challenge early; otherwise, the score decides the result when time expires.

pages.title: British Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Assemble car photographs in British Cars Jigsaw. The selection contains 12 pictures, each with three difficulty settings: 25 pieces for easy, 49 for medium, and 100 for hard. Use the mouse or touch controls to fit the pieces together and complete the chosen vehicle image. The larger piece counts divide the same picture into a more detailed puzzle.

pages.title: Fashion Nail Art
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Prepare and decorate a hand in Fashion Nail Art. Start with the washing activities, using the cleaning tools to apply soap, rinse away dirt, and dry the hand. Then choose nail colors and decorative nail-art designs, adding rings to finish the look. Use the mouse to handle the tools and select items as you move from cleaning to styling.

pages.title: Stack Fall 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Guide a ball down a tower in Stack Fall 2. Use the mouse to control its descent and work toward reaching the bottom. Completing that journey clears the current stage and lets you continue through more tower levels.

pages.title: Nova Defender
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Protect your base from repeated alien attacks in Nova Defender. Use the available weapons to fight the waves approaching your position, handling the action with mouse or touch controls.

pages.title: Halloween Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Fire colored bubbles into matching groups in Halloween Bubble Shooter. Use the mouse to direct your shots, bringing at least three balls of the same color together to make a match. Successful matches build your score. Check which color you are about to shoot and look for a group it can join.

pages.title: Sweet Puzzle Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Rebuild pictures from jigsaw pieces in Sweet Puzzle Time. Choose a picture and select its easy, medium, or hard mode before putting the sections together. Mouse and tap controls let you handle the puzzle pieces. There is no time limit, leaving you free to compare the shapes and image details while completing the scene.

pages.title: Brick 2048
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Arrange falling numbered bricks and create merges in Brick 2048. Shift each incoming brick across the board and guide its drop into position, building your arrangement around the pieces already placed. The game shows the next brick as well as the current one, helping you plan ahead. Keep combining bricks while working to improve the score recorded by the ranking system.

pages.title: Crowd City 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Gather a larger following than rival groups in Crowd City 2. Use the left mouse button to control your crowd as you travel through the city and recruit more people. Growing the group gives you the numbers to overwhelm opponents. The goal is to become the town's biggest crowd by combining recruitment with confrontations against the other groups.

pages.title: Stickman fugitive
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight to survive a police pursuit in Stickman fugitive. The stickman is surrounded by special forces and must shoot enemies while trying to escape their attack. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to handle the action. Your goal is to keep resisting the pursuit for as long as you can.

pages.title: Match Arena
pages.creator: The Pew Pew
pages.description: Compete in match-three puzzle duels in Match Arena. Face other players or connect with friends, working through challenges on the way to the Golden League. Quests award chests, while the boards introduce elements such as lava, honey, and unusual gravity. Watch how an opponent approaches the puzzle and adjust your choices for a rematch as you continue through the different settings.

pages.title: Crazy Traffic
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive through a crowded road in Crazy Traffic. Guide the car among the surrounding vehicles and avoid colliding with them as you continue through the traffic.

pages.title: Destroy The Eggs
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Remove wooden boxes to break the eggs in Destroy The Eggs. Click or tap a box to make it disappear, changing the support beneath the falling character. Guide that descent through the eggs to destroy them, clearing every egg required for the next level. Letting the character reach the bottom before the task is finished ends the attempt.

pages.title: Zombie Survival
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fight through an outbreak that has turned your friends into zombies in Zombie Survival. Begin with a basic pistol and work to stay alive against the hordes, purchasing other weapons such as a shotgun, machine gun, rifle, or laser gun. The isometric action offers three modes: Survival, Hard Point, and Nuke. Choose a mode and see how long you can last through the outbreak.

pages.title: Rock Paper Scissor
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Choose a hand sign and challenge the computer in Rock Paper Scissor. Set an in-game stake, then select rock, paper, or scissors to reveal the round's result. The game compares your choice with the opponent's hand and reports a win, loss, or draw. Winning adds to the displayed balance, while a loss costs the amount committed to that round.

pages.title: Hamsternikus
pages.creator: kpded
pages.description: Guide a scientist trapped in a hamster's body through maze puzzles in Hamsternikus. A failed mind-transfer experiment has left him needing help, with 100 levels standing in the way. Work through layouts containing movable walls and portal puzzles as the journey introduces an extraterrestrial threat. Study the maze's arrangement and find a route for the hamster to continue.

pages.title: Penalty Challenge
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Take both sides of a football shootout in Penalty Challenge. Choose from 32 teams, then try to score with five penalty attempts and save five kicks from the opposition. Swipe a finger to send a shot toward goal. When defending, move the mouse or a finger to position the goalkeeper's gloves. Success depends on scoring your own chances and stopping the opponent's replies.

pages.title: Smash The Bubbles
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Pop rising bubbles before they escape in Smash The Bubbles. Tap a bubble to burst it and add to your score, then move your attention to the next one. Missed bubbles cost lives, and their speed increases during play. Keep up with the bubbles to extend the attempt and improve the best score recorded by the game.

pages.title: Bottle Shooter
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Break the falling targets in Bottle Shooter. Shoot the bottles before they reach the bottom and smash, while keeping your shots away from the bombs mixed into the action. Watch which object is coming next before firing. The challenge is to clear the bottles in time without accidentally hitting a dangerous target.

pages.title: Soccer Master
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Swipe to strike the ball toward goal in Soccer Master. The swipe's direction and strength shape the kick as you try to get past the goalkeeper and work around the level's obstacles. The game includes 100 random levels, stars to collect, and eight players to unlock. Adjust each attempt to the current arrangement of the ball, obstacles, and goal.

pages.title: Pizza Party
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Prepare customer orders by selecting pizza ingredients in Pizza Party. Check what each customer wants and click the ingredients needed for that recipe, earning points for serving the meal. The Help section contains the recipes when you need a reference. Too many unhappy customers end the game, so pay attention to the requested pizza as you handle the orders.

pages.title: Cinderella’s Back to School Collection
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Prepare a school-themed fashion show in Cinderella’s Back to School Collection. Help Cinderella present her autumn designs with Jasmine and Aurora as models. Choose school outfits and create makeup looks for the show, balancing the collection's fashion styling with its dress-code theme. Compare the clothing and cosmetics as you put together the models' finished runway appearances.

pages.title: Ariel Street Trend Spotter
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Find street-style inspiration and recreate it in Ariel Street Trend Spotter. Join Ariel as she photographs outfits around the city for her fashion blog. After the photo hunt, help Elsa and Jasmine copy looks featured in the pictures. The activity connects taking fashion photographs with a dress-up stage, using Ariel's finds as references for the princesses' outfits.

pages.title: Princess Style Guide 2017: Glam Rock
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Style Jasmine and Elsa for a fashion-magazine feature in Princess Style Guide 2017: Glam Rock. Explore the theme through clothing, accessories, and makeup, with glitter, leather, and metal details shaping the looks. Choose combinations for the two princesses as they model the magazine's glam-rock selection. Bring the outfit and cosmetic choices together for each finished appearance.

pages.title: Bubble World
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shoot gemstone bubbles and collect the diamonds in Bubble World. Make groups of at least three matching gems to clear them, opening a route to the diamonds placed in the layout. Each level allows only a limited number of moves, so consider where a shot will connect before firing. Work toward gathering every diamond within the available attempts.

pages.title: Jack & the Beansteak: Gold Rush
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Climb for coins in Jack & the Beansteak: Gold Rush. Help Jack make his way up the stalk, collecting gold while dodging the obstacles along it. The goal is to climb farther and gather as many coins as possible during the ascent. Watch the next section of the stalk as you keep Jack moving past its hazards.

pages.title: Candy Galaxy
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Draw chains through matching sweets in Candy Galaxy. Connect at least three candies of the same type to remove them, making longer chains to obtain a booster. Each level has objectives to complete before the timer runs out. Use the mouse to make your connections and focus on the candies needed for the current goals as the clock counts down.

pages.title: Spider Story
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Defend a spider's home from rats in Spider Story. Click toward a target to fire a web shot, using rebounds from platforms to reach enemies that are awkward to hit directly. Clear the rats from the level and try to do it with fewer shots for a better star result. Look at the platform arrangement before choosing where to aim.

pages.title: Elsa Ice Skating Injuries
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Elsa recover from a skating accident in Elsa Ice Skating Injuries. Begin the medical-simulation activities by helping Olaf remove her skates, then use the game's tools to clean and bandage her injured foot. Work through the treatment tasks before moving to the dress-up stage. Choose a new dress and a matching pair of skates for Elsa's return to the rink.
